candidates.description: This vector is related to mathematical and symbolic notation commands used in typesetting languages like LaTeX.
Mathematical symbols, operators, and logical grouping characters used in equations and expressions.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters and subword tokens.

This vector represents non-English or multilingual character sequences, particularly Southeast Asian script fragments and accented Latin characters, often acting as subword noise or formatting artifacts in tokenization.
This feature vector activates on a random mixture of multilingual subword fragments, punctuation, and typographical noise without a unified semantic theme.
This feature vector activates on common consonant characters from the Thai alphabet.
This vector is related to mathematical and LaTeX formatting syntax, specifically superscripts, subscripts, and equation alignment.
This vector activates on various combinations of closing parentheses, curly braces, and associated punctuation marks.
This vector represents mathematical symbols, operators, and scientific notation used in equations and formulas.
This vector represents syntactic symbols, whitespace characters, and programming-related punctuation commonly found in source code or markup languages.
